name: Vikunja
description: To-do app with lists, kanban, Gantt and shared projects

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database (vikunja.db), task attachments (files) and .service_secret, this install's own key made on first start. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Vikunja web UI, API and CalDAV, published on host as 6761

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: VIKUNJA_SERVICE_ENABLEREGISTRATION
variables.description: true lets anyone make an account on the sign-in page. Set it to false after you and your people have made accounts.

variables.name: VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL
variables.description: The address people open Vikunja at, like http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6761 or https://tasks.example.com. Leave it empty to use Vikunja in the browser; set it for links in emails, CalDAV and sign-in with OpenID.
